name: get_current_job
description: The technician's open job right now: site and unit.

name: get_account
description: A customer account: contract type, approval threshold, approver, and facilities contact.

name: get_equipment
description: A unit at a site: model, warranty status, and part history.

name: check_part
description: Search the parts list by part id, name, or the model it fits. Returns price, stock, supplier, and ETA.

name: get_calendar
description: The technician's calendar for a date, as the technician app shows it.

name: order_part
description: Order a part from its usual supplier. Subject to the technician's permissions.

name: cancel_order
description: Cancel an order if the supplier still allows it.

name: request_approval
description: Send a purchase approval request to the account's approver.

name: open_warranty_claim
description: Open a warranty claim with the unit's manufacturer.

name: hold_slot
description: Put a tentative hold on the technician's calendar. A hold can be released.

name: book_return
description: Book a return visit on the technician's calendar.

name: release_slot
description: Release a hold or booking on the technician's calendar.

name: message_customer
description: Send a message to the customer's facilities contact or approver.

name: escalate
description: Hand a question or problem to a person: the technician, dispatch, accounts, or sales.
